hypothesis: Porting the 2026 walk-forward result of arXiv:2606.00060 (hourly BTC: return-magnitude REGRESSION plus a cost-aware execution filter that only changes position when |forecast| exceeds k x roundtrip cost restores after-cost profitability where sign/classification strategies fail at 10bps) to SOL beats the closed classification survey, because the survey's diagnosed failure margin is small (LGBM control gross edge was approximately +9bps/trade vs 10bps cost) and the paper attacks exactly that margin: hourly decision cadence cuts turnover, magnitude filtering skips sub-cost trades, and weak signals HOLD the existing position instead of exiting.

research.prior_failure_reassessment: btc_1h_native_swing_entry closed on BTC with a 1h TB-classification design (5/5 VAL-positive flipped 0/5 OOS) -- different asset, classification target, barrier execution, and no cost-aware magnitude filter; it does not test this recipe. The SOL survey itself closed only classification/quality/RL/trailing axes; a regression target with an execution-side cost filter was never run on SOL. The 2606.00060 evidence is 27-fold walk-forward on 8 years of hourly BTC with the exact 10bps cost figure this project uses.
research.retest_design: Same pinned SOL panel, splits, purge (288 bars + 288 embargo for DL), standardization, sizing (margin 0.30 x leverage 3), and contract seeds. Decision cadence: every on-the-hour 5m bar; target: next-hour open-to-open log return of the exact segment the decision controls (enter open[i+1], next decision segment boundary open[i+13]); execution: position-target replay on the 5m grid, 5bps per side on notional at position changes, weak signals hold the current position. Closed grid: k in {1,2,3} x side in {long_short, long_only} = 6 configs per model family. Families: LightGBM regression (paper's best family, deterministic single fit) and TabM-flat regression (N=5 contract seeds, DL emphasis). VAL-only selection per family (>=15 position entries); each passing family earns ONE OOS read; TabM adoption additionally needs seed-mean OOS > 0 with >=3/5 seeds positive. Failure closes the cost-aware-regression axis on SOL.

model.candidate_architecture: LightGBM return regression (single deterministic fit) and TabM-flat return regression (5 seeds), each with cost-aware execution filter |yhat| > k*10bps and hold-on-weak-signal position logic at 1h decision cadence

selection.validation_pass_criteria: per model family: best of the 6 pre-registered (k, side) configs on VAL PnL (seed-mean for TabM) must be > 0 with >=15 position entries; one OOS read per passing family; TabM OOS adoption requires seed-mean > 0 and >=3/5 seeds positive
